summary: Stood up pigallery2's own Express backend at era Node 10.24.1 on 127.0.0.1:32701, pointed it at each built lane in turn (dist symlink), seeded with 3 locally-generated PNGs, and witnessed both serially through the pipeline's witness host with real Chromium. Baseline lane runs: bootstraps, routes to /gallery/, two 200 API calls, 3 photo tiles. Migrated lane loads all bundles 200 then dies on 'ReferenceError: $localize is not defined' before bootstrap, zero API calls. parity.identical=false; T009c's shell parity superseded. successfulNonLoopback 0 both lanes. CLI live-backend path is gated on a closed app-name list, so the seam was operated, not extended. All five verification commands pass.
open_questions: The migrated lane's $localize defect is named, not diagnosed to its root: no rebuild with @angular/localize/init was attempted, so it is not established that adding the polyfill is sufficient. That is the obvious next unit, and T010 should price pigallery2 on a negative live-backend result until it lands.
